blurb: Fremont Abbey Arts Center is a nonprofit community organization presenting intimate seated concerts, modern dance, multi-arts shows like The Round, visual, literary, culinary arts, and much more. Fremont Abbey is a venue for many events such as weddings, receptions, nonprofit auctions, galas, benefits, etc.
